observed_result: Two whole-brain three-cell matrices ran the same wiring, the same parameter set and the same stimulus through the original, plastic and learned_then_frozen cells, both exit 0 and neither with a non-finite value. Each cell is 165,122 neurons, 25,563,197 edges and 300 LIF steps, and all 25,563,197 edges carried fast changes (plasticity.enabled_edges), so the two plastic cells advanced one step per core call (chunk_size 1). (1) Wall clock and memory: 1252.44 s real (874.32 user, 268.43 sys), 6,605,570,048 bytes maximum resident set size and 14,563,535,768 bytes peak memory footprint for the decay_p 0.5 matrix, whose three cells took 137.51 s, 611.82 s and 494.04 s; 1217.28 s real (874.65 user, 254.32 sys), 6,558,416,896 bytes maximum resident set size and 14,069,049,880 bytes peak memory footprint for the decay_p 0.999 matrix, whose three cells took 89.58 s, 598.64 s and 519.41 s. The estimate written before the runs was about 0.30 s of plasticity per step on 25,563,197 edges (Effective about 0.12 s, Step about 0.19 s, measured separately) on top of the 0.31 s per step of evidence/NAT-01, so about three minutes per plastic cell; the measured plastic cells are 611.82 s and 598.64 s, well inside the 90 minute per cell limit, so no step count was lowered. (2) The original cell is the run without the block: its four probe series, its monitors, its assumptions, its core_config_hash and its parameter_hash are byte identical to the single whole-brain derived run recorded in evidence/NAT-02/simulate-derived-v1/report.json, and the two matrices produce byte identical original cells even though they were built from different binaries. Only protocol_hash differs from NAT-02, because the stimulus gained the gate channel. (3) decay_p 0.999 (evidence/NAT-06/compare-plastic-persistent-v1): the fast changes reach a Euclidean norm of 11.902496517509498 by the end of the plastic cell and the frozen cell holds exactly that value from its first step to its last (plastic_l2_before = plastic_l2_after = 11.902496517509498, clamped_by_plastic_max 0 because no update is applied). The plastic_max bound held 34,549,873 entries during the plastic cell and the w_min floor held none. Silent fraction 0.6439844478627924 -> 0.5921197659912065 -> 0.5944937682440862, maximum per-step population rate 0.07934739162558593 -> 0.08569421397512142 -> 0.08362301813204782, no stability flag and all five declared thresholds passed in all three cells. The deltas_from_original of the plastic cell are ALIN mean_rate +0.04375 in the gate window and +0.0585 after it, ALIN activity ratio +0.1733333333, descending_neuron spike_fraction -0.07229832572, descending_neuron mean_rate after -0.003318112633, descending_neuron activity ratio -2.126829268, vnc_motor spike_fraction +0.002824858757 and vnc_motor mean_rate +0.01221751412 in the gate window; the frozen cell keeps ALIN at +0.06666666667 and +0.07283333333, moves descending_neuron spike_fraction to -0.0502283105 and its activity ratio to -50.14818182, and lowers vnc_motor latency by 3 steps. vnc_motor_activity_ratio_after is undefined in the original and plastic cells because the baseline window has rate zero, so its delta stays undefined in every cell even where the frozen cell has a value of 32.90588235. (4) decay_p 0.5 (evidence/NAT-06/compare-plastic-v1): the same plastic cell still differs from the original (ALIN mean_rate +0.04375 in the gate window, descending_neuron spike_fraction -0.03272450533, vnc_motor spike_fraction +0.04096045198), but the fast changes decay by half per step once the gate closes, so 250 steps later the whole array is down to a norm of 8.083189933121256e-75. The learned_then_frozen cell therefore reproduces the original exactly: its whole run report is byte identical to the original cell apart from the plasticity block, protocol_hash and the one added assumption, and the fourteen defined deltas are all 0 (the fifteenth, vnc_motor_activity_ratio_after, is undefined in every cell of that matrix). Whether a fast change survives to the end of a run is decided by decay_p, not by the implementation. (5) The report states differences and thresholds only. deltas_from_original is the per-metric difference from the original cell, defined only when both sides have a value; no cell carries a sentence calling a change an improvement, a modification or damage.
assumption_statement: parameter_source is derived_release/v1 with unknown_sign exclude and weight_scale 21.6, read from one parameter set file, so nothing here is a measurement: edge signs are rule-derived from predicted per-T-bar transmitter probabilities and bias, log_tau, theta_raw and the zero delays are uniform engineering values, exactly as evidence/NAT-02 states. The plasticity rule is the reference hebbian_rate law of main specification 10.3 and every one of its constants is a declared engineering choice with no measured basis: decay_e 0.5 (an eligibility half-life of one step), decay_p 0.5 in the first run and 0.999 in the second, plastic_max 0.01 (about one fifth of the median derived weight magnitude, which after weight_scale 21.6 is about 0.05), w_min 0.0001 and gate_scale 1. The learning gate is a channel of the stimulus the user declares, constant 1 over the 20 steps after the pulse; it is not produced by a receptor or a modulator, which is a later ticket. The fast changes are never written back into the parameter set. Under the exclude policy the 2,754,056 edges whose sign the derivation rules left unknown carry sign 0 and base weight 0, so plasticity treats them as free edges and a fast change can give such an edge a non-zero weight; that is a consequence of enabling every edge under that policy, not a separate assumption. Nothing here is a claim about plasticity in the animal.

limitations: Every constant of the rule and the gate is an engineering choice; see assumption_statement. The run report repeats them in its assumptions field.

No null model was run alongside the learning variants, so this matrix does not separate how much of the change is the wiring's doing. That comparison needs the ticket 14 null models in the same protocol and is a different question with its own cost.
Each matrix ran once. There is no repeat measurement, and the wall clock and resident set size include other agents compiling and testing on the same machine.

The w_min floor held no edge in either whole-brain run (clamped_by_w_min 0), so the guarantee that a fixed sign edge never crosses zero is exercised on the fixture (simulate.TestPlasticFixedSignEdgeIsHeldAtWMin) and not on real data.
The plastic_max bound held 33,391,125 and 34,549,873 entries, so a large minority of edge steps sat at the bound; the recorded deltas are the behaviour of a bounded rule, not of the unbounded law.
stdp_pair was not run on real data. It is covered by the hand calculation on the fixture only.

simulate run has no entry point that saves or restores the fast changes, so a plastic run cannot be continued across processes; --state-in and --state-out are refused together with the block rather than silently dropping the fast state.
The matrix compares three cells over one stimulus. It says nothing about a task, a reward or whether the change is useful.
